# Lost Garden

> Lost Garden is a poetic dark fantasy anime series created solo by Frank Houbre with an AI-assisted, human-led production workflow. Episode One (17 minutes) follows Lanterne, a voiceless hollow knight who awakens beneath the earth and must protect Rose, a mysterious child. The site is available in English, French, Japanese, and Korean.

Key facts:
- Creator: Frank Houbre (one-person studio, France)
- Format: independent animated dark fantasy series, original world and screenplay
- Episode One: 17 minutes, released 29 May 2026, free on YouTube, selected at the Seoul International AI Film Festival and finalist at the AI London Festival
- Production: AI-assisted pipeline supervised by a human creator (writing, art direction, editing, music, sound design)
- Languages: en (default), fr, ja, ko. Every page exists at /en/, /fr/, /ja/, /ko/ prefixes
